name: Primrose Hill Playground
description: Royal Parks playground for children up to 12, recently improved. It has a giant scramble net, a musical floor, swings, climbing nets and a new roundabout, around a central beach area with a wheelchair-accessible water play feature, a large sandpit with a raised table so children of all abilities can play together, logs, boulders and a wobbly bridge. The works are finished but the council says it will reopen soon, so check before you go.
